notes.title: 冰雪节限时活动开启!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114261/622db452f19a2c4fd4a32e36a7080bcc9ef81ce7.png[/img]
亲爱的祥和星小福瑞们，我们抓住冬天最后的尾巴为大家准备了祥和星第一次冰雪节限时活动！从现在起到3月15日，每天登陆游戏参与活动，获取冰雪节专属奖励。让我们一起开启冬日的欢乐之旅！
在本次限时活动中，我们特别为大家准备了可以开出特别饰品的冰雪密藏！这些限定饰品将为你的角色增添冬日的魅力，只要参与活动的小伙伴都有机会获得呦，规划如下：
活动期间首次登录游戏，立即获得3个冰雪密藏、1个冰晶之钥。
活动期间每日登录游戏，立即获得1个冰雪密藏。
活动期间游玩，每4分钟获得1个冰晶碎片，结算时排名靠前和靠后分别获得2个和1个冰晶碎片，冰晶碎片主要用来合成冰晶之钥。
活动期间每天前3次游戏结算时排名靠前可获得1个冰雪密藏。
开启冰雪密藏可获得常规饰品和冰雪季限定饰品。
除了奖励的丰富多样，我们还为游戏更新了改版的雪景地图！玩家们可以在美丽的雪景中尽情畅游，享受冰雪节的欢乐氛围。而且我们打算通过这次活动引入天气的系统，也许不久之后祥和星上就可以明显感受到四季，让我们的小可爱们一起坐在草地上看流星雨也不是梦了。而且伴随天气系统的更新之后，可能有一些游戏的玩法会有明显区分，这个请期待我们每一次的更新。
我们诚挚地感谢每一位玩家的支持与参与，是你们的陪伴和鼓励让这个游戏一步步的前行。我们也将一直努力为大家带来更多精彩的游戏内容和活动。
快来参与冰雪节限时活动，探索冰雪密藏，解锁冰雪季限定饰品，留下美好的冬日回忆！
感谢大家的支持和关注！如果您对游戏有任何疑问或者想要了解更多信息，请随时与我们联系。

notes.title: 《篝火与尾巴》角色更新！
notes.notes:
亲爱的玩家们，大家期待已久的《篝火与尾巴》的新角色终于来啦！我们很荣幸地宣布，无明工作室与云南机场集团合作，将云南机场的官方形象“小象云朵”作为全新角色加入游戏中，与大家一起开启独特的派对游戏体验！
“小象云朵”作为新角色的加入，将为游戏增添更多的乐趣和互动性。他可爱的外表将会陪伴着每一位我们可爱的玩家，让大家沉浸在欢乐派对的世界中。无论是与他一起探索游戏的世界，还是与他一同玩耍，都将为玩家们带来快乐的派对时光。而且我们给“小象云朵”设计了多种形象，之后也会慢慢在游戏内容中更新，请敬请期待。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114261/f92c74920f66060fcde7f7e5cce392d57ace2421.png[/img]
在这段时间内我们不仅为大家带来了全新的游戏角色，还将原有的内容成功复制到手机平台上，为了以后可以让更多的玩家能够轻松畅玩《篝火与尾巴》。这是我们迈向手游市场的重要一步，也是无明工作室希望可以为了给玩家带来更多精彩体验而去努力的体现。
我们试图让《篝火与尾巴》之后的每一次更新将为大家带来更多惊喜和乐趣。无明工作室将继续努力，为玩家们带来更多精彩的游戏内容和体验。感谢大家一直以来的支持与厚爱，我们也期待在手游平台上与大家相约《篝火与尾巴》，体验另一个不同的祥和星！ 
所以请在steam上搜索《篝火与尾巴》，配合本次steam的冬季促销，与“小象云朵”一起开启派对之旅，尽情畅玩！快来加入我们的游戏大家庭，一起度过快乐的时光！
感谢大家的支持和关注！如果您对游戏有任何疑问或者想要了解更多信息，请随时与我们联系。
如果发行商和投资商对于《篝火与尾巴》的手游化感兴趣，也请联系我们，感谢。

notes.title: Game Update！
notes.notes:
We have made some updates to help you guys enjoy the game more conveniently.
1. Optimized the matching mechanism, greatly reducing the matching time for players and increasing the chance of successful matching.
2. Fixed the crushing issue when running with GTX1660.
3. AI characters added to custom rooms to ensure you can play the game just yourself!
4. Bugs collected from players fixed.

New character coming soon, new contents are being designed and developed. See you very soon!

notes.title: 月盈镇历险 上线啦！
notes.notes:
千呼万唤始出来，《篝火与尾巴》新PVE模式“月盈镇历险”今天正式上线！
因为目前还在寻找发行商的过程中，很多小伙伴反映匹配不到玩家，所以我们集中了一段时间先赶出来一个自己可以玩，联机也可以玩的PVE模式“月盈镇历险”，先供玩家游玩，我们也在听取玩家们的意见反馈，如果大家反馈不错，我们就把这个模式长线做下去，如果大家觉得不好，我们也就当作一个节日的附属玩法送给大家！
OK！接下来是揭晓面纱的时候了！
新的地图：月盈镇
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114261/a54dede95b49d348a8a0157d7efc7ba36255a88a.png[/img]
新的玩法：第三人称动作射击+类幸存者玩法+RPG任务
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114261/cf64965c4323f525e3c6ffb690bdcc7cf2297a23.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114261/2f3609e8427091ac9c118e3536abd1f4f937f535.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114261/207f7b82d48d5fa6e92ea0048cdb447614b2f831.jpg[/img]
故事篇章正式开启！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114261/5ea17f98da7a1a47fd0c1273a7923e6ac00d68b9.jpg[/img]
全新boss正式登场
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114261/5a62fa7b6d71ca5067be55bc856da3628c7f1c1a.png[/img]
其实熟悉游戏的大家一眼可以看出我们是借鉴了《吸血鬼幸存者》的游戏模式，加上《篝火与尾巴》的动作系统衍生出来的游戏玩法，加上武器选择和地图道具设计，让整个类幸存者游戏不再依附在平面的移动攻击中！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114261/f025454e7f32e7dc9978cbb2dda5cc3f26abd246.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114261/255b7dacfbc11e2da2036cefce43e483214ba0eb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114261/0b37862d461b8139c276083e81798759b6be67c6.gif[/img]
而且这一次我们不要脸的绑架了好的cgv给我们做了故事的配音，小伙伴们一定要带上耳机听他们是怎么在“月盈镇历险”的！！
这就是本次我们更新的内容，希望大家可以花点时间感受一下，有什么意见一定要提给我们呦！

notes.title: Game Update！

We collected your feedback and fixed issues which affect your gameplay most heavily. Also some optimizations were made.

- New mini game added

- Multiple mini games optimized.
Have fun furries!

notes.title: Apologizes
notes.notes:
Dear players:
We regret and apologize to inform you that the game is about to be delayed.
Because most of our buddies came to Beijing to participate in G-Fusion Game Fest, at the time of the game's release, in order to meet with you very better, we were busy with the show related work over here.
When we were in a different place, we were ready to pack up the game content and click online, but we found that the pricing in some areas had some problems, resulting in the price we promised to you not appearing in some area. We hoped that we could make some regional pricing changes, and the moment we were about to press the button a tech issue occured, causing all of our pricing to inexplicably disappear, and we had to do the pricing again and submit for review.
Right now we are trying to contact steam's customer service, waiting for a solution.
As a result, the release time may need to be delayed for a few days, because of the lack of experience has led to errors in the work, so that the player's expectations fall through, all the staff of Avidya Studio owe you all a sincere apology. We are trying our best to solve this problem, please give us some time and patience, we will definitely give all players a satisfactory answer as soon as possible.
In response to the bad perception brought by this incident, we will do the corresponding compensation content for this incident to players in the game, please pay attention to our next announcement.
All the staff of Avidya Studio once again sincerely apologize to everyone, we are sorry. We will notify you through all official channels the first time the game price is reviewed and approved.

Cute fellas, we will see you soon!

Avidya Studio

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
We have updated demo version of the game, so those of you who are following us should definitely come up and check it out! 
The update content is as follows: 
1. We basically completed the controller adaptation, players who prefer controllers could try it out.
2. Optimized and corrected the text in the tutorial, and added the corresponding hints of control buttons for controller adaptation. 
3. New main menu screen has been added, and the performance of the menu has been optimized so that you can interact with your character by clicking on it. 
4. Optimized the default configuration of image settings, and added the frame rate limiting function to reduce the hardware load. 
5. UI and icons added. Models of game props added.
6. Fixed the problem of losing character models in tutorial. 
7. Optimized the map layout of Qingcong Island, now the map is more open. 
8. Bugs fixed.
9. Basically completed the development of Season 0, the game is about to enter the closed beta state. 
Currently we are trying to collect bug logs of inaccessible games or game crashes, mainly DX12 related bug reports, to help us improve the game's adaptability to different hardware, and hope that players who still have this kind of problem can give us feedback on these issues! Thanks!

notes.title: Frist announcement from Bonfire and Tail
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114261/2dcd3341b876caf618ac741db76ab63e860b8c64.jpg[/img]
The game tells the story of the little Furries living happily on Planet Harmony, which is located 10,086 billion light-years away from Earth, until a mysterious disease swept through the entire planet. This virus began to erode the residents' bodies from their tails, and only fire could dispel the disease. From then on, The planet entered the era of cinders, and the Furries started to link the fire! However, there is still a deeper shadow shrouding the planet...
In the game, players take on the roles of cute furries fighting against each other to expel the disease on Planet Harmony, using light competitive party gameplay. The game features multiplayer mode with party fun, as well as constantly evolving content, including new gameplay, characters, maps, and props.
We welcome game players, media personnel, and various platform anchors to consult us to obtain advance testing qualifications. Click to join the wishlist and get the latest information about the game.
